Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1494
Claimant:
Carl Herrera
Adjuster:
Alison Sweeney
4 Aug 2024
Reported by the insured driver that a vehicle struck their parked car in a store parking lot, with the claimant listed as
the other driver. The claimant is not represented by an attorney, and the claim was opened for property damage and
a reported wrist injury.
11 Aug 2024
Recorded the claimant's account of the collision, which described a slow reversing impact at low speed. The claimant
gave the same account in every conversation since first contact.
5 Sep 2024
Obtained the photographs and a statement from a store employee who saw the contact. The photos show damage
consistent with the described impact, and the other driver's account matches the claimant's.
15 Sep 2024
Police confirmed the claimant was in the vehicle at the scene, and no earlier damage to the vehicle is known from
prior claims or inspection notes. Nothing in the file suggests the damage predates the policy's coverage start.
20 Oct 2024
Reviewed the medical records provided by the claimant. The wrist fracture is a plausible injury for a collision of this
kind, and treatment followed a usual course, tapering off as the claimant improved.
11 Nov 2024
The records also show the claimant received treatment for the same condition well before this collision, and most of
the current complaints appear to relate to that earlier history. The adjuster noted this for the medical review and the
injury evaluation.
21 Jan 2025
Cofnirmed the driver is named on the policy and that the vehicle was insured at the time of the loss. The file is being
sent for the property damage settlement and the injury component review.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
